description: This file defines middleware functions for security-related HTTP handling in a Node.js/Express application, including CORS configuration, helmet security headers, and rate limiting.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for handling CORS with a dynamic whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for setting security headers with relaxed CSP and cross-origin resource policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for rate limiting requests, configurable via environment variables.
